test.create_query: CREATE TABLE max_by_sorting_key_100 (symbol String, ts DateTime64(3), price Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (symbol, ts)
CREATE TABLE max_by_sorting_key_10k (symbol String, ts DateTime64(3), price Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (symbol, ts)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO max_by_sorting_key_100 SELECT 'SYM' || toString(number % 100), toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3) + toIntervalMillisecond(intDiv(number, 100) * 10 + number % 7), (number * 7919) % 10000 / 100 FROM numbers_mt(50000000)

INSERT INTO max_by_sorting_key_10k SELECT 'SYM' || toString(number % 10000), toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3) + toIntervalMillisecond(intDiv(number, 10000) * 10 + number % 7), (number * 7919) % 10000 / 100 FROM numbers_mt(50000000)
test.query: SELECT symbol, max(ts), argMax(price, ts) FROM {table} GROUP BY symbol SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_max_by_sorting_key = {optimize} FORMAT Null
SELECT symbol, min(ts), argMin(price, ts) FROM {table} GROUP BY symbol SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_max_by_sorting_key = {optimize} FORMAT Null

SELECT symbol, argMax(price, ts) FROM {table} WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-01-01 00:00:10' AND '2026-01-01 00:40:00' GROUP BY symbol SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_max_by_sorting_key = {optimize} FORMAT Null

SELECT symbol, argMax(price, ts) FROM {table} WHERE symbol IN ('SYM1', 'SYM2', 'SYM3', 'SYM4', 'SYM5', 'SYM6', 'SYM7', 'SYM8', 'SYM9', 'SYM10') GROUP BY symbol SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_max_by_sorting_key = {optimize} FORMAT Null
SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM {table} SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_max_by_sorting_key = {optimize} FORMAT Null
SELECT count(DISTINCT symbol) FROM {table} SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_max_by_sorting_key = {optimize} FORMAT Null
SELECT symbol, ts, price FROM {table} ORDER BY symbol, ts DESC LIMIT 1 BY symbol SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_max_by_sorting_key = {optimize} FORMAT Null
